components.name: Multi-step checkout form
components.full_description: A three-step checkout form with inline validation, a progress indicator, and keyboard-accessible navigation between steps.
components.install_instructions:
npm install react-hook-form zod

Requires Tailwind CSS already configured in your project (this component uses Tailwind utility classes; installing react-hook-form and zod alone will not style it).

components.name: Command palette
components.full_description: A keyboard-first command palette (cmd+k) with fuzzy search and grouped results.
components.install_instructions:
npm install cmdk

Requires Tailwind CSS already configured in your project for the overlay/radius styling (cmdk itself ships unstyled).
